brief: An FPV drone pit station: a two-storey workbench for a drone pilot, seen from the front. Along the back, a row of six cells two storeys tall: at each end a tower of drawers for spare parts, one drawer on each storey with its front facing the viewer, and between the towers four bins on the top storey, most of them divided, holding M3 screws, nuts and standoffs. In front of the back row, a covered deck one storey high as the work surface. Lay a work pad along the deck with a 5-inch quad on it, a multimeter and a hex driver set at the pad's free end, and the radio and the goggles on the deck beside the pad, one on each side. Put the deck nearest the default view and the back row farthest from it, and use look to check the view.

finish.summary: Built the two-storey bench carcass: 6-cell back row two tall with end drawer towers (4 drawers), 4 top-storey bins (div2/div3 mix) stocked with M3 screws, nuts and standoffs, and covered front deck. Dressing failed: the 450mm work-pad was refused (overlaps the back-row cell wall), so the pad, quad, multimeter, hex driver set, radio and goggles are not placed and the look check was not done. check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
